name: Chimelong Hotel
description: Chimelong Hotel is a five-star hotel inside the Chimelong resort, about 0.3 to 0.9 km from the park depending on the source, with a free resort shuttle and the White Tiger Restaurant. Rates shown are rough estimates and change a lot by date.

name: Chimelong Panda Hotel
description: Chimelong Panda Hotel is a panda-themed hotel inside the Chimelong resort, about 0.8 km from the park, with the Panda All Day Dining Restaurant. Rates shown are rough estimates.

name: Atour Light Hanxi Changlong
description: Atour Light Hanxi Changlong is a three-star budget hotel about 0.9 km from the park in Dashi, Panyu, with a high guest rating. The link goes to a booking page. Rates shown are rough estimates and can be much higher on peak dates.

name: Chimelong Xiangjiang Hotel
description: Chimelong Xiangjiang Hotel is a four-star hotel next to the Chimelong Safari Park in Dashi, with a free shuttle to the Chimelong attractions that reviewers say is infrequent and stops early in the evening. The distance to the park is not confirmed. The link goes to a booking page. Rates shown are rough estimates.

name: Holiday Inn Express Panyu Dashi
description: Holiday Inn Express Panyu Dashi is a budget hotel about 2 to 2.5 km from the park, next to Dashi Station on Metro Line 3, with free breakfast and free parking for guests. There is no shuttle. Rates shown are rough estimates.
